description: Universal container for dashboard composition and standalone card layouts. Owns sizing variants, a named container query scope, state overlays (loading/empty/error), optional interactivity and selection state.

attributes.name: data-resize-mode
attributes.description: Experimental: "drag" enables a pointer-driven snap-resize grip (default mode uses the header overflow menu only)

attributes.name: data-menu-open
attributes.description: Reflected while a descendant menu is open

attributes.name: data-interactive
attributes.description: Makes the container a clickable surface

attributes.name: data-selectable
attributes.description: Makes the container a selectable radio option

attributes.name: data-group-position
attributes.description: Managed by an enclosing <sherpa-container-group>: "first" | "follow". The first tile in a group renders its header normally (and serves as the group title); follower tiles have header content visually muted while the header band preserves height for cross-tile content alignment. Consumers should not set this manually.

slots.description: Main content (dashboard children or card body)

slots.name: header
slots.description: Card-style header (use sherpa-container-header); edge-to-edge with separator

events.name: card-click
events.description: Fired when an interactive container is clicked or keyboard-activated

events.name: card-select
events.description: Fired when a selectable container's selection changes

events.name: container-increase-cols
events.description: Bubbled from injected resize menu items

events.name: container-decrease-cols
events.description: Bubbled from injected resize menu items

events.name: container-increase-rows
events.description: Bubbled from injected resize menu items

events.name: container-decrease-rows
events.description: Bubbled from injected resize menu items
